title: Lead Days for a Fresh Proof of Continued Use — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Allowance.** When the item list of a refill request is worked out in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, an item is listed when its supply runs out no more than the horizon after the request, the horizon being the schedule's ship-window days together with the lead days, and lead days for a fresh proof of continued use are added to that horizon, read from the continued-use date on the enrollment:

- **5 days** when the enrollment's continued-use date is no more than 30 days old;
- **2 days** when it is older than 30 days but less than 6 months old;
- otherwise none.

## Measuring the age

| Age of the enrollment's continued-use date on the handling day | Lead days |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 calendar days | 5 |
| 31 days or more, and fewer than 6 whole calendar months | 2 |
| 6 whole calendar months or more | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, handling day 15 July)

- Continued-use date 15 June: 30 days old, 5 lead days.
- Continued-use date 14 June: 31 days old, under 6 whole months, 2 lead days.
- Continued-use date 16 January: 5 whole months, 2 lead days.
- Continued-use date 15 January: 6 whole months, no lead days.
